group.title: A request for quotation
group.passage:
To: Valley Components
Subject: Quote for a pilot build

We need 240 locking connectors for a pilot build scheduled for September 18. Please quote both the unit price and freight to our Taoyuan plant. Your catalogue lists a minimum order of 500 pieces. Could you make an exception for this trial? If the trial passes, our expected monthly requirement will be 3,000 pieces.

We need the trial parts at the plant by September 12. Please state the delivery date in your reply rather than only the number of production days. A drawing of the required connector is attached.

Mira Wu, Purchasing
group.passageZh:
收件者：Valley Components
主旨：試產用零件詢價

我們需要 240 個鎖扣式連接器，用於九月十八日的試產。請分別報出單價及運到桃園工廠的運費。貴公司的型錄列出最低訂購量為 500 個，這次試作是否可以例外？若試產通過，預計每月需求為 3,000 個。

試作零件最遲須在九月十二日送達工廠。回覆時請註明交貨日期，不要只寫生產天數。附件是所需連接器的圖面。

採購部 Mira Wu
